courses.overview: 由微弱訊號、誤差預算與校準延伸到兩種可繼續實作的工法；比較共享物理關係與不能直接複製的條件。
courses.overviewEn: Extend small signals, error budgets and calibration into two guided courses, comparing shared physical relations and nontransferable conditions.

related.title: 高速類比數位轉換器
related.why: 類比前端必須把訊號準確交給 ADC。
related.whyEn: An analog front end must accurately deliver signals to an ADC.
related.transfer: 類比前端必須把訊號準確交給 ADC。
related.transferEn: An analog front end must accurately deliver signals to an ADC.
related.difference: 高速 ADC 的取樣回踢、時鐘和介面限制不同於慢速直流精度。
related.differenceEn: High-speed ADC kickback, clock and interface limits differ from slow DC accuracy.
practice: 把「訊號與共模」的概念圖與「高速類比數位轉換器」的輸入輸出對照。
在固定差模下掃描共模頻率，檢查輸出誤差斜率。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：高速 ADC 的取樣回踢、時鐘和介面限制不同於慢速直流精度。
practiceEn: Compare the signal and common mode concept map with inputs/outputs of High-speed analog-to-digital converters.
Sweep common-mode frequency at fixed differential input and inspect output-error slope.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: High-speed ADC kickback, clock and interface limits differ from slow DC accuracy.

related.title: 精密數位類比轉換器
related.why: ADC 與 DAC 兩方向都依參考和誤差預算。
related.whyEn: Both conversion directions depend on references and error budgets.
related.transfer: ADC 與 DAC 兩方向都依參考和誤差預算。
related.transferEn: Both conversion directions depend on references and error budgets.
related.difference: DAC 需額外驗證輸出負載、毛刺與建立時間。
related.differenceEn: DACs additionally need output-load, glitch and settling checks.
practice: 把「感測器負載」的概念圖與「精密數位類比轉換器」的輸入輸出對照。
將兩種濾波頻寬的 RMS 雜訊比值與平方根比例比較。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：DAC 需額外驗證輸出負載、毛刺與建立時間。
practiceEn: Compare the sensor loading concept map with inputs/outputs of Precision digital-to-analog converters.
Compare RMS-noise ratios for two bandwidths with the square-root law.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: DACs additionally need output-load, glitch and settling checks.

courses.connectionEn: Transfer the basic models to related courses while rechecking materials, scale, environment and acceptance boundaries.

history.title: 從元件機制到系統設計
history.titleEn: From component mechanisms to system design
history.text: Texas Instruments 的原廠技術資料提供本課的可追溯起點。差動毫伏訊號可以疊加在較大的共模電壓上。 本課以自行編写的教學模型連到「微弱訊號、誤差預算與校準」，不主張地圖所標機構發明了全部技術。
history.textEn: Manufacturer documentation from Texas Instruments provides a traceable starting point. A millivolt differential signal can sit on a much larger common-mode voltage. Independently authored models connect this to small signals, error budgets and calibration; the mapped organization is not claimed to have invented all these techniques.

history.title: 從標稱數據走向驗證證據
history.titleEn: From nominal metrics to verification evidence
history.text: 本課進一步處理這個系統問題：開關電容輸入在取樣窗中抽取電荷，驅動器必須及時建立。 以「比較取樣率和源阻抗改變時的碼值偏移。」練習判讀；這段是公開原理的學習脈絡，不是機構的發明年表。
history.textEn: The course then examines a system issue: A switched-capacitor input draws charge during acquisition and must settle in time. Practice interpretation using: Compare code shifts as sample rate and source impedance change. This is public-principle learning context, not an institutional invention timeline.
